statement: For all fixed rectangular complex B p-by-n,M m-by-n, r=min(m,rank stacked[B;M]), prove aggregate positive-spectrum-log L1 and Elogdet(I+rho X^H X)-r log(rho) tends its finite expectation, X=ZB+M, Z proper independent CN1. No uniformity in B,M.

proof.text: At a maximal-rank deterministic witness, positivity of coefficient plus sum-of-squares selects one fixed nonzero coordinate minor.
Establish its physical-entry polynomial is nonzero and its evaluation nonzero AE; use accepted fixed-compression log L1.
On AE rank event derive 2log|P|<=S<=trace and |S|<=trace+2|log|P||. Treat rank0 separately.
Apply accepted conditional aggregate offset after supplying actual aggregate L1.
